name: Kamiwazumi Chinami
source:
Hobbies: Proposing
Skills: Shooting, horseback riding
Likes: Looking out from windows
Dislikes: Dark, narrow places
Favorite food: Rice balls (Made by [url=/c17268]Shotarou[/url])
Hated food: Caviar, foie gras, tryffels

Shotarou's childhood friend who is a lively and carefree girl who never looks down on anybody, despite being wealthy. She is grateful to Shotarou as he often came to play with her despite her sheltered childhood, and was able to become more positive thanks to him. She owns a white horse called "Grand Slam", which she rides every day to get to school. When sitting quietly, Chinami looks just like a typical, beautiful rich girl.
